note: Free-text questions, one run each. Not the pinned-scenario path.

asks.question: how come you couldn't price the asbestos soffit removal on our tender? What does that actually cost?
asks.interpreted_as: Strip and dispose of bonded (non-friable) asbestos-cement soffit/eaves lining from a single-storey timber-framed house in Auckland, area assumed >10m2 (Class B licensed work, WorkSafe notifiable), ground-level access, waste to consented landfill; removal only, reinstatement lining priced separately.
assumptions_invented: Material is non-friable asbestos cement sheet, not friable board or sprayed coating
Single storey, ladder or light scaffold access, no restricted-access or two-storey work
Soffit area exceeds 10m2 so Class B licence and 5-working-day WorkSafe notification apply
Fascia, roof sheets and wall cladding behind are asbestos-free and not in scope
Auckland as the pricing centre
Removal and disposal only; new soffit lining is a separate item
Occupied dwelling requiring containment and neighbour notification, but no full enclosure
asks.unit: lump sum, soffit/eaves removal on a single-storey house
asks.basis: NZ contractor and cost-guide web pages only. QV CostBuilder has no asbestos coverage at all across all 9,816 indexed rows. GST treatment is not stated by any source, so this band cannot be confirmed as GST-exclusive. Excludes survey, clearance certificate and reinstatement lining, which are listed separately. Treat as an order-of-magnitude range pending three licensed quotes.

components.role: Licensed Class B removal of AC soffit lining, incl containment, disposal and site clean
components.unit: lump sum, typical house eaves run
components.caveat: Contractor marketing pages, not a rate book. GST treatment not stated by any source - likely GST-inclusive retail. QV CostBuilder contains no asbestos rows whatsoever.

components.role: Per-m2 cross-check on removal rate
components.caveat: Spans all material types and locations; soffits sit at the upper end because area is small relative to set-up, access and containment cost.

components.role: Pre-removal asbestos sampling and identification report
components.caveat: Plus GST, as stated by the source. Lower figure is a single sample; upper is a typical multi-sample residential round.

components.role: Refurbishment / demolition survey
components.caveat: 'From' price plus GST. Rises with building size, complexity and travel.

components.role: Clearance certificate on completion
components.caveat: 'From' price plus GST. Independent party required. Licensed assessor and air monitoring are mandatory for Class A only, not Class B.

components.role: Hazardous waste disposal to landfill
components.caveat: Wrong centre - used only as a sanity check. No Auckland asbestos gate rate is published; Redvale, Whitford and Hampton Downs accept asbestos but do not publish the charge. Usually bundled into the removalist's lump sum.

components.role: Reinstatement: new fibre cement eaves lining (QV, area basis)
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV row. HardieFlex 4.5mm incl PVC mouldings to sheet joints. Lining only - excludes framing and fascia.

components.role: Reinstatement: new fibre cement eaves lining (QV, lineal basis, 600mm wide)
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV row. Use this OR the m2 row above, never both. Do not add either to row 05507449e3aed084cd6a9d8c1d66d530536ce71004098595e4ca04ee74122a26:t4:r3 (AKL 173.00/m), which is the complete soffit including framing and fascia and already contains the lining.

qv_sources.desc: HardieFlex™ Eaves Lining, 4.5mm thick, including pvc mouldings to sheet joints

open_questions: Actual soffit area or lineal metres - the single biggest price driver, and the reason the range spans 4x
Whether the material is genuinely asbestos, and whether bonded or friable (Class A vs Class B changes the rate materially)
Auckland landfill gate rate per tonne for asbestos waste - not published by Redvale, Whitford or Hampton Downs
Scaffold or access cost as a separate line - QV holds only painting rates for working off scaffolding, not scaffold hire itself
Whether published removal figures are GST-inclusive or exclusive
WorkSafe notification fee, if any, for licensed removal work
Two-storey, restricted-access or occupied-building loadings
suppliers_to_ring: Chemcare (national, asbestos removal and cost calculators by region)
Aerem (licensed asbestos assessor, clearance certificates and air monitoring)
Waste Disposal Services - Whitford Landfill (Auckland asbestos gate rate)

asks.question: Our tender flagged liquefaction-prone ground. What does ground improvement cost for a single-storey light commercial building in Christchurch, and how common is this problem?
asks.interpreted_as: Ground improvement works only (excluding the building slab), per m2 of building footprint, for a single-storey light commercial slab-on-grade building in Christchurch on liquefaction-prone ground, using the undercut-and-replace method (excavate, engineered gravel raft, triaxial geogrid) at 1.0m to ~2.3m depth; plus a qualitative prevalence answer on liquefaction-prone ground across the Christchurch district.
assumptions_invented: Footprint 300-800 m2, single storey, slab-on-grade, no basement
Ground is TC2 or TC3-equivalent; the tender did not state a technical category or CPT results
Undercut-and-replace is the selected method, not RAPs, stone columns or deep soil mixing
Improvement depth 1.0m (low) to approximately 2.3m (high)
Water table sits below the excavation, so no dewatering is priced
Spoil is clean and uncontaminated, carted approximately 10km
Light commercial floor loading (retail/office), not racked warehouse
Slab, foundations and superstructure are excluded from the band
asks.basis: Low end is the sum of QV CHC rows t12:r3 + t12:r4 + t12:r5 = $218.80/m2 for a 1m undercut-and-replace with geogrid, rounded to $220. High end is the QV CHC aggregate total row t13:r14 = $420/m2 for an approximately 2.3m imported-GAP40 replacement with two geogrid layers. Excludes the slab, dewatering, geotechnical investigation, consultant fees, contaminated spoil and P&G. All source rows come from QV's Canterbury RESIDENTIAL foundation tables, which use an NZS 3604 slab as the deduct baseline; a commercial building is specific engineering design and may land above this band.

components.role: Excavate 1m deep and dispose, 1.37m3 per m2
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV row from a residential TC1/TC2 table; no dewatering, no contaminated spoil allowance

components.role: GAP65 hardfill, 1m deep, compacted, 1.37m3 per m2
components.caveat: Unreviewed; aggregate supply is volatile and quarry-distance sensitive

components.role: Triaxial geogrid, 1.63m2 per m2
components.caveat: Unreviewed; single-layer allowance, commercial SED may require two layers

components.role: Deeper replacement package, imported GAP40 - aggregate total for TC3 Type 1 (excavate/dispose 3.1m3, compact subgrade, GAP40 compacted, 2 layers geogrid with 3m return)
components.caveat: Aggregate total row flagged total_or_build_up_check_components - must NOT be added to its own components t13:r10-r13; residential TC3 basis

components.role: Alternative deeper package re-using excavated material rather than importing fill
components.caveat: Aggregate total row; only valid if the excavated material is geotechnically suitable for re-use, which a CPEng must confirm

components.role: Prevalence context - district-wide liquefaction vulnerability mapping extent
components.caveat: This is the mapped study area of flat land, not the area assessed as vulnerable; no published category split found

asks.question: Client wants to know the cost impact of switching the roof from long-run coloursteel to a membrane on a 1200m2 warehouse.
asks.interpreted_as: Cost delta of substituting 1200 m2 of 0.55mm pre-finished high-rib trapezoidal long-run steel roofing on purlins (with underlay, netting and flashings) for a sheet membrane roof on a new continuous plywood deck, on a simple low-pitch portal-frame warehouse, new build, Auckland, GST exclusive, no insulation either side.
assumptions_invented: 1200 m2 is roof area not floor plate; low pitch so the two are within ~1%
Base spec is 0.55mm pre-finished (MagnaFlow/MAXAM) high-rib trapezoidal, the normal warehouse covering
Membrane requires a new continuous substrate because it cannot span purlins; 17mm H3 plywood deck assumed
Simple roof: no parapets, no roof plant, existing spouting and downpipe layout retained
Auckland centre
New build, not a re-roof (no strip-out or asbestos)
Neither option insulated; warm-roof build-up excluded
No scaffold/edge-protection duration difference allowed
asks.unit: m2 of roof (cost IMPACT, membrane less long-run)
asks.basis: Membrane build-up of deck proxy $89/m2 plus sheet membrane $69-$137/m2 = $158-$226/m2, less the QV composite long-run all-in rate of $116/m2. Over 1200 m2 this is +$50,400 to +$132,000 GST exclusive. Excludes insulation, tapered falls, purlin changes, internal gutters and warranty. Band is wide because the deck rate is a proxy and QV publishes no single-ply TPO row.

components.role: base case: long-run coloursteel, all-in
components.caveat: Composite row already includes wire netting, underlay and 0.1m flashing per m2 — must not be added to the covering-only rows in table 528b0345...:t1. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: base case alternative profile (LT7)
components.caveat: Same inclusions as above; shown only to confirm the base band is stable across warehouse profiles. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: membrane case: continuous deck (proxy)
components.caveat: WEAK PROXY. This is plywood cladding fixed to timber frame, not a roof deck over steel purlins. QV indexes no roof-deck-on-purlin plywood row. Excludes extra purlins or nailing strips. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: membrane sheet, low end
components.caveat: Soprasun 4AR torch-applied single layer. Single national price, no centre differentiation, which is itself a reliability flag. Excludes deck. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: membrane sheet, mid
components.caveat: Polibit double layer 6-7mm Novaflex. Excludes deck. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: membrane sheet, high end
components.caveat: Butyl 1.5mm black, explicitly 'laid to falls on plywood or concrete' — deck excluded. Excludes skirtings, outlet dressings and gutter linings, all separately priced in the same table. UNREVIEWED.

components.role: cross-check: NZ single-ply TPO installed (not in QV)
components.caveat: Roofing contractor marketing blog, not a cost authority. Unsourced, no spec or inclusions stated, may or may not include deck. Use only to confirm the QV-derived membrane band is not absurd.

components.role: adder not included: roof drain for internal gutter
components.caveat: Sureflow 100mm dia with clamp ring and dome grate. Quantity not established — depends on whether the membrane design introduces internal gutters. Not in the band.

components.role: adder not included: nailing strip to purlins for plywood deck
components.caveat: Component rate, deliberately NOT rolled into the band. At 900mm centres this is roughly 1.11 m per m2 of roof. Purlin recentring for a plywood deck is a structural decision not yet made.

open_questions: Single-ply TPO/PVC roofing (Viking Enviroclad, Nuraply) — the system actually specified on NZ warehouses; QV indexes no TPO or PVC single-ply row at any thickness
Rigid insulation board (PIR/EPS) and tapered insulation to create falls on a warm roof — no QV row found; frequently $60-$120/m2 and could double the delta
Plywood or steel tray roof decking over steel purlins as a roof element — QV has no such row; only cladding and flooring plywood proxies
Structural consequence of the added deck dead load and any purlin recentring, and the engineer's fee to reassess the portal frame
Internal gutter, sump and overflow quantities that a low-pitch membrane design would introduce
BRANZ-appraised system cost, producer statement and installer warranty premium for the membrane package
Scaffolding and edge-protection duration difference between the two trades
Whether this is a new build or a re-roof — a re-roof adds strip-out, disposal and possible asbestos, none of which is priced here
suppliers_to_ring: Viking Roofspec (Enviroclad TPO system and nearest approved applicator)
